text: @nn12138/dsh-voice 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的语音输入插件，在会话输入框旁增加麦克风按钮，并支持可配置的全局快捷键。它通过浏览器端捕获语音，将识别结果作为普通聊天消息提交；自动模式会在可用时采用主机本地识别，未配置本地模型时回退到浏览器 Web Speech。识别过程中可显示部分文本，停止后提交本轮文本。适合希望免手动打字、通过语音向网页会话发送消息的用户。基本浏览器识别无需额外密钥；本地识别需另行安装 sherpa-onnx-node 并配置模型目录。

@nn12138/dsh-voice adds a microphone button and configurable shortcut to DSH web chats. It recognizes speech in the browser or, when configured and available, on the host with local models. Partial text appears while speaking; stopping submits the recognized message. Browser mode needs no API key.
想直接说话，把内容发到网页里的 DSH 会话。
能不能在聊天输入框旁边加一个麦克风按钮？
让 DSH 网页版支持用语音输入消息。
打字不方便时，我想按一个快捷键开始或停止语音识别。
希望说话时能看到正在识别出来的部分文字。
想在本机离线完成语音转文字，再把结果发进对话。
语音识别结果能作为普通聊天消息发送吗？
I want to dictate a message into my DSH web conversation.
Can I use a keyboard shortcut to toggle microphone input while chatting?
I need speech recognition that can run locally with downloaded models.
@nn12138/dsh-voice 的功能「麦克风语音输入」：点击会话输入框旁的麦克风按钮开始或停止识别，识别文本会作为普通消息提交。
@nn12138/dsh-voice 的功能「快捷键控制」：使用配置的全局快捷键切换当前会话的麦克风识别，输入框聚焦时不会触发快捷键。
@nn12138/dsh-voice 的功能「引擎自动选择」：engine 设为 auto 时查询主机能力；本地模型可用则使用本机识别，否则使用浏览器 Web Speech。
@nn12138/dsh-voice 的功能「实时识别回显」：识别过程中更新部分文本，停止识别后将本轮定稿内容提交到开启识别的会话。

@nn12138/dsh-voice README · dsh-voice 🎤：**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

A voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness: click 🎤 in the web UI (or press a hotkey), speak, and the recognized text is submitted as a normal chat message. **Input only** — it never touches the agent preset/persona, so it behaves like "another input method" in every mode.

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nn12138/dsh-voice)
[](LICENSE)

@nn12138/dsh-voice README · Features：- 🎤 **Voice input**: microphone button (platform design-system UI) + configurable global hotkey (Ctrl+Space by default)
- ⚡ **Live recognition**: streaming partial transcripts are echoed while you speak; VAD finalization commits on stop (0.6s tail padding keeps sentence endings)
- 🧠 **Adaptive dual engine**: host-native ASR (sherpa-onnx-node zipformer2 + silero VAD, offline/private) with automatic fallback to browser Web Speech (zero extra dependencies)
- 🔌 **Preset-agnostic**: does not touch the persona/system prompt; works with code/standard/minimal/custom presets
- 📦 **Optional models**: zero-config out of the box; run `dsh-voice-models` when you want native offline recognition

@nn12138/dsh-voice README · Optional: configuration (edit ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml)：```

```yaml
- id: voice
  config:
    modelDir: './dsh-voice-models'   # native ASR model directory
    hotkey: 'ctrl+space'             # global hotkey
    vadThreshold: 0.3                # lower = less clipping at sentence boundaries
    tailPadSeconds: 0.6              # tail-padding duration
    engine: auto                     # auto (default) | native | browser
```

@nn12138/dsh-voice README · Optional: configuration (edit ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml)：The row-level `config` is received by the host half. `engine` and `hotkey` are synced to the browser half over the `/voice.config` loopback RPC, so there is no separate client config to write. `auto` probes host native capability: with a model it uses native; without one it falls back to Web Speech, so zero-config users keep working. Restart `dsh web` after changing the config.

```sh
dsh web   # 🎤 button appears on the left of the composer, or press Ctrl+Space
```
@nn12138/dsh-voice README · Optional: configuration (edit ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml)：See [USAGE.md](USAGE.md) and [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) (Chinese) for details.

@nn12138/dsh-voice README · How it works：```
Browser captures mic audio (auto-resampled to 16 kHz)
  → PCM base64 chunks (256 ms) → /voice RPC channel (loopback)
  → host: silero VAD + zipformer2 streaming decode
  → partials returned per chunk (live echo) / finals committed

Engine selection: the host resolves the effective engine (config + model-load result) and the client consumes it via `/voice.ping` — native unavailable falls back to browser Web Speech. `/voice.config` carries the row-level `engine`/`hotkey` from host to client.

@nn12138/dsh-voice README · Development：```sh
pnpm install --ignore-workspace        # standalone deps (no DSH monorepo needed); no install-time scripts
pnpm --ignore-workspace test           # unit tests (including real-model smoke tests)
pnpm --ignore-workspace typecheck      # type check (against the in-repo structural stubs)
pnpm --ignore-workspace build          # build (tsc host half + tsdown client half)

@nn12138/dsh-voice README · Development：The build only ever runs on the publisher's side (`prepack` — at `npm pack`/`npm publish` time) and in CI before release; consumers installing `@nn12138/dsh-voice` from the registry never execute lifecycle scripts, so `--ignore-scripts` installs are complete and usable (see issue #2).

@nn12138/dsh-voice README · Keeping up with DSH：`typecheck` runs against the hand-written stubs in `src/ambient.d.ts`, which cannot detect DSH API drift by construction — the stubs describe whatever the source already assumes. Two checks close that gap:

@nn12138/dsh-voice README · Keeping up with DSH：- **`verify:runtime`** (no DSH install needed) replays the real `client-modules` resolution contract: it loads `lib/client.js` through the live platform module table, then calls `apply()` on both halves with contexts shaped like the shipping API. A bundle that requires a module the platform no longer seeds fails here instead of silently at page load.
- **`verify:types`** compiles `src/` with `src/ambient.d.ts` **excluded**, resolving each specifier to the real packages in a DSH install. Point it at one:

@nn12138/dsh-voice README · Keeping up with DSH：```sh
DSH_PACKAGES_DIR=<dsh>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai pnpm --ignore-workspace verify:types
```

It exits 0 with a skip notice when `DSH_PACKAGES_DIR` is unset, so CI stays green without a DSH checkout. Run it before a release against the DSH version you target.

Real-model smoke tests look for the local `voxelf` assets and skip when absent; override with:
`DSH_VOICE_MODEL_DIR` (model directory) / `DSH_VOICE_TEST_WAV` (test wav) / `DSH_VOICE_DOWNLOADED_MODELS` (downloaded model directory).

@nn12138/dsh-voice README · Keeping up with DSH：Layout: `src/index.ts` (host half) / `src/client/` (browser half) / `src/core/` (recognition core) / `tools/` (wire-protocol smoke tools + model downloader).
